description: Exact source fragments from the public Binance chart persistence implementation, with original dependency factories.
offset_contract: Zero-based UTF-16 String.slice offsets; exclusive ends; SHA-256 uses UTF-8 bytes.

extraction.declarations: Lexical dependency closure; exact original declarator/function slices.

wrapper_contract.runtime: Existing captured Rspack runtime; localForage module 43917 comes from the existing fixture.
wrapper_contract.tv: Only original persistence helpers and save callback; storage/key/widget/onSave references are supplied by the test.
wrapper_contract.basic: Original Wo/Dc and their helpers; React subscriptions, debounce and Ec JSON serialization are not executed.
wrapper_contract.mirror: Original async callback and original SWC/lodash dependencies; namespace is supplied, Cr.current=false and _r.current=true select the native enabled branch.
wrapper_contract.exclusions: No chart rendering, exchange requests, login, production records, or real-page adapter installation.
